method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation of the Emergency Services Levy Act 2002 (No. 39 of 2002), mrdoc 24246 retrieved 2026-09-07, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_24246.txt; compilation table ending with the Fire and Emergency Services Legislation Amendment Act 2012 (No. 22 of 2012). Operative rules: Fire and Emergency Services Act 1998 (No. 41 of 1998) Part 6A and ss 3, 3A, mrdoc 49451 retrieved 2026-09-07, deposited at ../../../fire-and-emergency-services-act-1998/registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49451.txt. The annual Gazette determination of ESL categories, rates, minimum and maximum (FES Act ss 36G-36I; indexed as wa/emergency-services-levy-annual-determination, text not deposited) supplies inputs only; the figures in the cases are illustrative.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the land owner, for the WA life event Chloe c055: ESL Act s 3 (the levy imposed; the Act fixes nothing else); FES Act s 3 definitions (leviable land, levy, levy year; gross rental value a fact); s 3A(a)(i), (d) (owner); s 36B (land in an ESL category area); s 36D (regulation exemptions a fact); s 36E (other enactments' exemptions do not apply unless later and express); s 36F(3); s 36G(1)-(2) (determined before 31 May); s 36H(1), (3) (rate in the dollar of GRV at 1 July; another basis); s 36I (minimum and maximum); ss 36J(1), (3), (4), 36L(1)(b), 36P(2) (the notice, with the council rate notice; whom to pay); s 36M(2) (35 days); s 36O; s 36P(1), (3) (owner liable; joint and several); s 36Q, s 36R(2) (instalments, agreements); s 36S(1), (5) (interest); s 36T(1)(a), (2) (apportionment; reimbursement); s 36Z(1) (recovery from a later owner); ss 36ZC(1)-(2), 36ZD (sale after 3 years, 6 months' notice; caveat); ss 36ZE, 36ZF, 36ZH (objection to purpose of use, 60 days; SAT; still payable; refund; 30 days). Not encoded: the rest of the FES Act; s 36A, 36C, 36G(3)-(5), 36H(2), 36L(1)(a), 36N, 36R(1), 36S(2)-(4), 36T(1)(b), 36U-36Y, 36Z(2), 36ZA, 36ZC(3)-(5), Division 9 (ESL agreements); the Rates and Charges (Rebates and Deferments) Act 1992; the actual rates.
